    HIGH SCHOOL WITH CURRICULUM TRANSFORMATION

    #

    NotAnOrdinaryHighSchool

    UPH College is a high school under the Pelita Harapan Education Foundation (YPPH) that specifically prepares students for university level education. Every year, around 1700 students from 38 provinces in Indonesia attend UPH College, and approximately 30% of the students reside and experience boarding life.

     

    Located on the Global Campus of UPH Karawaci, UPH College, with its world-class facilities, provides students access to discover and develop their talents. Since its establishment in 2010, UPH College has graduated more than 4000 students who are currently pursuing their education and careers around the world.

     

    The faculty members of UPH College demonstrate high dedication and have undergone rigorous selection processes, equipped with various training in relevant fields and interests. They not only impart knowledge and skills to students but also shape their characters.

    "The transformation of Indonesian education"
